about.intro: I studied architecture before moving into professional 3D visualization, then expanded into software by building utilities around real production friction. Most of my work starts from operational gaps, repetitive manual steps, or curiosity about how rendering, interaction, and data can connect into cleaner technical environments. This portfolio is not a static gallery - it is an active workspace containing production tools, visualization experiments, runtime research, and reusable infrastructure shaped by practical needs.
